name: Otherside
source:
A fairly short visual novel about trying to find your missing friends. You will find yourself in a strange house with a mysterious man. 

[From [url=https://minyth.itch.io/otherside]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部相当短篇的视觉小说，讲述寻找失踪朋友的故事。你会发现自己身处一栋陌生的房子里，身边还有一位神秘男子。

[来源：[url=https://minyth.itch.io/otherside]Itch.io[/url]]
